task_instance: Given no connected product analytics tool, the user supplies a raw weekly metrics table (North Star WAU, signups, activation, DAU/WAU/MAU, D1/D7/D30 retention, churn, MRR/ARPU, NPS, support tickets) for 8 weeks including a mid-period incident. Produce a full weekly metrics review following the skill's required output format: Summary, Metric Scorecard (table vs previous period and target with status), Trend Analysis (attribution and significance), Bright Spots, Areas of Concern, Recommended Actions, and Context and Caveats.
evidence: Created metrics_raw.csv (8 weeks x 15 metrics, synthetic but realistic, including a deliberate incident-driven dip in the week of 2026-08-24 with a subsequent 3-week partial recovery). Ran a python3 script (inline heredoc via Bash) to compute week-over-week % change and vs-baseline % change for every metric, plus DAU/MAU stickiness ratio, printed as a table and cross-checked by eye. Used those computed numbers to write metrics_review.md, which follows the skill's exact Section 4 output structure (Summary / Metric Scorecard / Trend Analysis / Bright Spots / Areas of Concern / Recommended Actions / Context and Caveats), correctly identifies the Aug 24 anomaly by correlating the WAU drop with the support-ticket spike, flags attribution as correlational per the skill's Tips, distinguishes lagging metrics (D30 retention, NPS) from fast-recovering ones (MRR, signups), and ends with concrete recommended actions (investigate root cause, segment retention by cohort, run an experiment, invest in the strong funnel stage, set an alert on D30 retention) as required by the skill. Verified the deliverable by grepping metrics_review.md for all 7 required section headers (all present) and by confirming the scorecard's numeric values match the python computation output. Files: metrics_raw.csv, metrics_review.md in the work directory.
